Subject: Request: UK addendum + SCC annotations and subprocessor evidence

Jonas — thanks for the demo last week. Our legal team reviewed the standard Redwood DPA and asked whether you can: 1) provide a short UK IDTA addendum to sit alongside the DPA, 2) send an annotated copy of the SCCs mapping for the model/data flows we discussed, and 3) share up-to-date evidence for the subprocessor list (in particular: HSM/kms, analytics provider, and logging vendor).

We also need a path to signature (DocuSign preferred) and an estimate of how long it will take to finalize redlines. Can you confirm who from Redwood will own the redline and who will be the signer? We are aiming to close by year-end if possible.

Thanks,

Head of Legal Ops
Finexus Payments

Claire — really appreciate the clear ask and timeline. Quick plan below: 

- Redwood legal will prepare a short UK IDTA addendum draft (2–3 pages) and produce an annotated SCCs PDF showing which modules/processes map to each transfer clause.
- I'll own coordination and hand the addendum to Marcus (our contracts lead) for redlines. Lauren will pull the subprocessor evidence and the current KMS/HSM attestation table.
- We will prepare the DocuSign envelope and share a HubSpot record link for your procurement team.

Deliverables and ETA: 
- UK IDTA addendum (first draft): by Mon 2026-12-21 EOD UTC
- SCCs annotated PDF: Mon 2026-12-21 EOD UTC
- Subprocessor evidence matrix (spreadsheet): Tue 2026-12-22 midday UTC
- DocuSign envelope (pre-filled, for legal review): Tue 2026-12-22 afternoon UTC

If year-end close is the target, please confirm whether Finexus requires the UK IDTA to be countersigned by a named officer or whether a legal-designated signee is sufficient. We will default to a legal signee unless you ask otherwise.

I will attach the draft addendum and SCC notes once Marcus finishes the redline pass.

Thanks — talk soon.

Jonas Weber

Subject: Fwd: Draft UK IDTA addendum + SCC notes (redline pass)

Forwarding my redline pass — see attached. High-level notes for legal ops: 

- I tightened the indemnity reciprocity language and suggested carving session replay logs into the audit-log subprocessor category rather than general analytics to reduce transfer scope. 
- For the SCCs mapping I added explicit references for model inference (inference server logs) and for prompt storage (prefix caching — flagged as controller->processor pseudo-transfer; we annotated recommended supplementary safeguards).
- Subprocessor evidence: Lauren, please confirm latest HSM attestation and whether the analytics vendor (Pulselytics) has a DPA addendum that covers export to US-based analytics buckets. If not, we should flag this as an evidence gap.

Next steps: 
- Lauren: attach the subprocessor matrix and HSM attestation.
- Jonas: share the bundle with Finexus and open the DocuSign envelope after legal confirmation.

Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Claire — attaching the subprocessor matrix and current vendor attestations. I’ve highlighted the items that need Finexus acknowledgement: 

- Pulselytics (analytics): they have a DPA but it limits cross-border export to EU/UK; we propose a supplemental addendum to allow Finexus to access aggregated US-hosted analytics reports.
- KeyVault Inc (KMS/HSM): HSM attestation attached (cert valid until 2028).
- LogStream (logging): we maintain a contractual DPA; logs sent to US region only for retention reasons — see evidence tab.

DocuSign link (prepared, pending your legal ok on the addendum redlines): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/0a1b2c3d4e
HubSpot: HS-98745

If Finexus confirms a legal-designated signee is fine, we’ll send DocuSign today and aim for signature within 48 hours. If you need a named officer, we’ll need procurement to approve the final signatory and I can re-issue the envelope.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
